question.text: While mapping stakeholders for a SAS engagement, an SIA notes that 'funders, Government, volunteers and beneficiaries' are classified as EXTERNAL stakeholders of the social enterprise. Which of the following is the corresponding INTERNAL stakeholder list?

answer.text: Board members, employees, and contract/part-time staff (part of the organisation's internal management)
Regulatory authorities, donors, and the media
The target beneficiaries and indirect community members
Competitors, peer NGOs, and industry associations

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.8.3, internal stakeholders are individuals/groups that are part of the organisation — employees, board members, contract/part-time staff. External stakeholders (also called secondary) include funders, Government, consultants, volunteers and beneficiaries. The Trap: Option B mis-classifies regulators and donors as internal. Option C mis-classifies beneficiaries as internal — they are external primary stakeholders. Option D lists parties outside the mapping entirely. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 4 (Logic Model) for stakeholder mapping, and Ch 6 (Frameworks — GRI materiality). SIAs use stakeholder maps to plan evidence gathering and interview selection.
